summary: The authors adequately addressed the prior required revisions from the terminal review. The preregistered paired study was executed and archived as declared; validator-rule summary, contamination pointer, explicit statement that the secondary estimand is uncomputable, and an explanation of the degenerate CI/zero-discordant outcome appear in the manuscript and are supported by archived artifacts and hashes. Artifacts, execution accounting, and analysis artifacts appear internally consistent and reproducible. No new critical issues were introduced during revision. I recommend acceptance for finalisation conditional on no further editorial-formatting checks.
optional_revisions: Add a one-paragraph worked example that walks readers through one representative per-episode JSON validator.trace (validation_before → validation_after) to aid practitioners in interpreting archived traces.

Include the relevant adapter configuration snippet from execution/model_configuration.json and a one-sentence recipe in Methods for the suggested follow-up (independent-generation vs shared_initial_generation) so readers can reproduce the variant.
If space permits, add a small schematic figure contrasting the causal questions answered by shared_initial_generation versus independent-generation designs.
